avoid_r2_path.description: Host traffic currently congests R2, R3 has demonstrated spare capacity, and routing via R3 is allowed. Raise R1/R4 costs toward R2 to 300.

proposal.diagnosis: The offered traffic exceeds the stated preferred-path capacity while the alternate path has spare capacity.
evidence: Synthetic R2 path utilization is 0.96; R3 path utilization is 0.12.
The supplied topology has an alternate R1-R3-R4 path.
proposal.expected_effect: Move host-to-host traffic to R3; the controller must measure whether latency or utilization improves without reducing delivered traffic.

prefer_r2_path.description: Measurements support returning to the healthy intended R2 path; restore its endpoint costs to 10.

proposal.diagnosis: Restore the intended primary-path preference when measurements justify using R2.
evidence: The intended baseline assigns cost 10 to the R1-R2 and R4-R2 interfaces.
proposal.expected_effect: Prefer R1-R2-R4 when both paths are healthy; measure after deployment.
